Layout workload-test (lay_01M6CEVN3Q99AGV13QZ8XFVKNK), head revision rev_01M6CEVN3RJDDPE5E300B4JS64, board moergo/glove80.

On-screen layer styling: every board supports setLayerStyle for keyloom's layer colours, not keyboard LEDs. color is a palette index from 1 to 6 (null restores the default). The op also sets shortLabel: preserve the layer's current shortLabel, or use null when absent, if only changing colour. Hardware LED colours use setLayerLighting and are subject to the board capabilities below.

On-screen: layer colours and short labels (setLayerStyle; not keyboard LEDs). Can do: combos, tap dance, macros, hold-taps. Cannot do: per-key hardware LED colours (its lights are ZMK underglow, which shows one effect across all 80 LEDs, and MoErgo's firmware (v26.09) has no way to give a key its own colour on a layer).

Macros: none.
